notes: BANK STATEMENTS — A SECOND WAY TO RECONCILE, BESIDE THE ONE YOU HAVE. The Reconciliation screen and its quick import are unchanged. Banking, Bank Statements: import the bank own CSV or Excel export and the app treats it as evidence rather than as a list to match from. ITS OWN BALANCE PROVES IT. Before a single line is accepted the statement running balance is checked on every row — opening plus credits minus debits must equal what the bank printed, row after row. A file whose figures do not tie is refused at the first row that breaks, with both numbers shown. That check is what catches a mis-keyed or missing line before it ever reaches your books. EVERY LINE IS KEPT. Import the same month twice, or two exports that overlap, and nothing is added twice — a line is recognised by its content, not by the file it came in. HEADINGS ARE MAPPED ONCE PER BANK. The first statement from a bank you confirm which column is the date, the narration, the debit, the credit and the balance; every statement from that bank after that is read without asking. MATCHING. Press Propose matches: a debit on the statement is matched to an unpresented cheque, a credit to an uncredited lodgement — by reference where the narration carries one, by amount otherwise — and several lodgements that add up to one bank credit are offered together. A match with more than one candidate is offered, never chosen for you. Applying a match presents the cheque, or credits the lodgement, ON THE BANK DATE, through exactly the path the register already uses and with the same guard, so the reconciliation screen and its as-at view remain the single truth. Unmatch puts the item back. CHARGES AND INTEREST. A line the ledger never saw — a bank charge, interest, an SMS fee — is posted with Post, through the reconciliation own adjustment voucher on the bank date. A click each time; nothing is ever posted on its own. Tick Remember this and the narration becomes a rule the app proposes next month. Reverse undoes it through the ledger own reversal. NOT YET: PDF statements are not read — every Ghanaian bank internet banking offers a CSV or Excel export of the same statement; use that. FOUR NEW TABLES; no existing data changes. This installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
